# IMPERIA COLD WAR - South Africa 1970 Flavour On Actions
# Generated by saf_generator/build_saf_mod.ps1; edit the design/generator, not this file.

on_actions = {
	on_daily_SAF = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_initialized }
				COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_reconcile_bilateral_deals = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = SAF }
				SAF = {
					if = {
						limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_initialized }
						COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_reconcile_bilateral_deals = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_weekly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { original_tag = SAF } NOT = { country_exists = SAF } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_deal_partner }
				COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_cleanup_orphaned_partner_deals = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_peaceconference_ended = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = SAF }
				SAF = {
					if = {
						limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_initialized }
						COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_reconcile_bilateral_deals = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { original_tag = SAF } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_deal_partner }
				COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_cleanup_orphaned_partner_deals = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
